POLC-M1.description: Pushover Load Case (POLC-M1). Field applicability is driven by INCRE_METHOD (LOAD vs DISP, selecting which CTRL_OPT sub-fields apply) and by LOADPATTERNTYPE (LOAD/ACC/MODE/NOR_MODE, selecting which fields of each LOADPATTERN item apply).

LCNAME.description: Pushover load case name. Must be unique across pushover load cases.

NLTYPE.description: Geometric nonlinearity type. NONE = none, PDELTA = P-Delta, LARGE = large displacements. Case-insensitive.

bUSEINITIAL.description: Use initial load. When true, bREACOUTPUT must be provided; when false, bREACOUTPUT is ignored (stored as false).

bREACOUTPUT.description: [bUSEINITIAL=true] Cumulative reaction by initial load. Required when bUSEINITIAL is true; not used when bUSEINITIAL is false.

INCRE_METHOD.description: Increment method. LOAD = load control, DISP = displacement control. Determines which CTRL_OPT sub-fields are required. Case-insensitive.

CTRL_OPT.description: Control option. Which sub-fields apply depends on INCRE_METHOD (LOAD vs DISP) and their sub-options.

STEPCTRLOPTION.description: [INCRE_METHOD=LOAD] Stepping control option, required for LOAD method. AUTO = auto-stepping, EQUAL = equal step, INC_FUNC = incremental control function. Case-insensitive.

INCFUNC_NAME.description: [STEPCTRLOPTION=INC_FUNC] Incremental control function name (must reference an existing function). Required only when STEPCTRLOPTION is INC_FUNC.

STIFF_RATIO.description: [INCRE_METHOD=LOAD] Current stiffness ratio (Cs), required for LOAD method.

DISPCTRLOPTION.description: [INCRE_METHOD=DISP] Displacement control option, required for DISP method. GLOBAL = global max displacement, NODE = master node control. Case-insensitive.

GLOBAL_MAX_DISP.description: [DISPCTRLOPTION=GLOBAL] Global maximum translational displacement, required when DISPCTRLOPTION is GLOBAL.

MASTERNODE.description: [DISPCTRLOPTION=NODE] Master node ID, required when DISPCTRLOPTION is NODE.

MASTERDIRECTION.description: [DISPCTRLOPTION=NODE] Master node direction, required when DISPCTRLOPTION is NODE. Case-insensitive.

MASTERMAXDISP.description: [DISPCTRLOPTION=NODE] Master node maximum displacement, required when DISPCTRLOPTION is NODE.

LOADPATTERNTYPE.description: Load pattern type. LOAD = static load cases, ACC = uniform acceleration, MODE = mode shape, NOR_MODE = normalized mode shape. Determines which per-item fields of LOADPATTERN apply. Case-insensitive.

LOADPATTERN.description: Load pattern data list. Must contain at least one item. Which item field applies depends on LOADPATTERNTYPE.

LCNAME.description: [LOADPATTERNTYPE=LOAD] Static load case name, required for LOAD pattern.

DIR.description: [LOADPATTERNTYPE=ACC] Acceleration direction, required for ACC pattern. Case-insensitive.

MODE.description: [LOADPATTERNTYPE=MODE|NOR_MODE] Mode number, required for MODE and NOR_MODE patterns.

SF.description: Scale factor applied to this load pattern item.

1.DESC: Load control, static load case pattern

2.DESC: Load control with incremental control function
